answer_1.quote: We propose the Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debating (M-MAD) framework for MT evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: Quality scores (MQM scores) and segment‑level/system‑level evaluation metrics

answer_2.quote: We compare M-MAD against the following categories of metrics: 1) Reference‑free LLM‑as‑a‑judge methods... 2) Reference‑based metrics: XCOMET, MetricX-23, BLEURT-20, COMET, MaTESe, BERTScore; 3) Reference‑free metrics: COMETKiwi, MetricX-23-QE.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o mini as the primary model for all LLM‑as‑a‑judge methods and employ a multi‑agent debating framework to assess translations across dimensions.

answer_4.quote: The human MQM scores serve as the ground truth for evaluating the performance of automatic metrics.
answer_4.guideline: MQM annotation guidelines specifying error categories and severity levels for each segment.
